newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Quaker Oats Q1 EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Quaker Oats Q1 EPS view up.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said Thurday she had raised her first quarter earnings estimate for Quaker Oats Co to $0.25 a share from $0.15 but was maintaining her pro forma earnings estimate for the year at $1.80.

-- Ghez said the first quarter estimate excludes a one-time charge of about $8.40 a share related to Quaker's anticipated sale of its Snapple beverage business, but includes an expected operating loss for Snapple.
-- The full year estimate is based on continuing operations and excludes all results from Snapple.
-- Quaker Oats said today it expects first-quarter earnings to exceed analysts' consensus estimate of $0.18 a share and to at least equal the year-earlier operating earnings of $0.22.
-- Quaker said first quarter results would reflect strength in its cereals and its U.S. Gatorade sports drink business. It said U.S. ready-to-eat cereal volume was up 25 percent in the quarter.

-- "I don't think this is sustainable," Ghez said of the cereal volume increase. She also said Quaker's volume gains were partly the result of heavy promotions in the quarter at a time when cereal market leaders Kellogg Co and General Mills Inc cut back some of their promotional efforts.
